summary.name: Stop-Motion Animation. Category: Animation Techniques. Supplemental provenance, not a directly named style in the source collection. Authentic output requires photographed frames.
summary.visualIdentity: Physical-looking objects with stable materials, light, contact shadows and believable space. Held frames and incremental poses communicate weight. Controlled craft is kept, and accidental defects are not sought.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to craft brand films, product launches built from photographed sequences, process documentaries and educational craft content. Other uses are unspecified; any wider suitability is inferred.
summary.limitations: Authentic results need frame-by-frame photography, and code can only simulate the look. A simulation is not physical production and must not be presented as photographed. No renderer is listed, so missing frames must be reported or labeled as a Blender simulation. Avoid smooth high-rate text over low-rate footage.
summary.palette: Background is scene_dependent: choose it from subject, environment, lighting and mood, not by default. Example tokens (#ECE4D4 background, #3C443C foreground, #917F67 accent) are non-canonical and apply only to new presentation elements. Foreground on background measures 7.972; accent on background measures 3.057 and is decorative only. Gradients are disabled. Source sampling showed matte clay on a plain backdrop, and its backdrop hue was an author choice. Task-provided exact colors override all examples.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Holds and incremental poses follow the planned exposure rate, and delivery frame rate may be higher. Springs, bounce and added in-between poses are not part of this style. Optional references are motion-009 miniature parallax, motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-015 storytelling, motion-037 letter scatter and motion-038 punctuation zoom, which must not be passed off as a smooth warp. Video runs on composition time, while scroll or pointer input is optional interactive delivery with static reduced-motion states.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified in the source; no mandatory layer, genre, tempo or voice is assigned. Options to suggest per topic include silence, sparse accents on exposures, ambience, or narration with clear space. Do not invent beat or speech timing; use measured audio only when supplied. Honor any explicit user audio choice.
summary.assetRequirements: Numbered photographed frames or prepared layers with alpha are needed, with consistent dimensions and clear naming, inspected before composition. Optional creature, glyph or punctuation assets are used only when the scene contains them. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Blender with bpy is an alternative simulation route.
summary.combinations: style-093 kinetic type steps on the same exposures as the photographed objects, and text must stay off contact shadows and key objects. style-024 handwritten callouts suit process pieces, using ink #3C443C with #917F67 as the sole accent and annotating only during holds. Use this style alone for pure craft pieces.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline; Remotion is used only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, with the reason recorded. Photographs or labeled simulated frames supply the visuals. Python, Pillow and FFmpeg prepare and encode sequences, GSAP times motion, and chroma-js is optional for color validation. Verify decoded frames, seeks, audio sync and loop seams.
